'''Jabba's Palace Limited''' is the 12th expansion of Star Wars CCG, published by Decipher in April 1998.<ref name="expansions">[https://web.archive.org/web/19990504174938/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/productlibrary/thecollection/index.html Star Wars CCG: The Expansions] at Decipher.com (archive, 4 May 1999)</ref> It has 180 black-bordered cards (90 Light Side and 90 Dark Side): 80 rares, 50 uncommons, and 50 commons.<ref name="jpcards">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/jabbaspalace/light/index.html Jabba's Palace Light Side card list] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20020611184117/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/jabbaspalace/dark/index.html Dark Side card list] at Decipher.com (archive, 11 June 2002)</ref><ref name="cardlists">[https://web.archive.org/web/20081225225012/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/index.html Star Wars CCG cardlists] at Decipher.com (archive, 25 December 2008)</ref><ref name="allcards">[https://web.archive.org/web/20070928014432/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/swallcards.pdf Complete Card List] (Decipher PDF, archive 28 September 2007)</ref>

It is the first expansion from ''Return of the Jedi'', covering the opening of the film and the rescue of Han Solo from Jabba the Hutt. Debuts include [[Jabba The Hutt|Jabba the Hutt]], [[Princess Leia Organa]], [[Artoo (Jabba's Palace)|Artoo]], and a large cast of aliens at the palace. Like [[Cloud City Limited]], it was sold in 9-card packs whose last card was always the rare.<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009141805/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive]; see also [https://www.starwarsccg.org/collecting/ SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia] at starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022023930/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/collecting.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="wook">[https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba%27s_Palace_Limited Jabba's Palace Limited] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20190530070109/https://starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Jabba%27s_Palace_Limited Internet Archive] at Wookieepedia</ref>

== Packaging ==
Limited Edition was sold in 9-card booster packs (MSRP $2.50: 5 commons, 3 uncommons, 1 rare) and 60-pack booster boxes.<ref name="encyc" />

== Memorabilia ==
Decipher issued a four-panel poster (~32&Prime; &times; 10.5&Prime;) for every expansion from Premiere through Death Star II. Jabba's Palace reverse is the expansion card list.<ref name="encyc" />

[[File:Jabbas-Palace-Limited-four-panel-poster.png|360px|Jabba's Palace Limited four-panel poster front]]
[[File:Jabbas-Palace-Limited-four-panel-poster-back.png|360px|Jabba's Palace Limited four-panel poster reverse]]

''Front and reverse (Light Side / Dark Side card list)''

The booster box held the fold-out Jabba's Palace Rules Supplement (new rules, including Tatooine / Jabba's Palace location deployment, on one side; card list on the other).<ref name="encyc" />

Rares are 8&times;10 (80 cards): 40 rares twice per sheet. Uncommons and commons are each 10&times;10 (100 cards): 25 titles four times per sheet. The sheets below are recreations from the Collecting Encyclopedia.<ref name="encyc" />
